prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a pet friend to keep you company while you work."]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Companion", "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls, start chat, or adjust visibility.", "Got It"]
2: ["Upload Pet Photos for Custom Creation", "Provide clear, well-lit photos so our AI generator creates an accurate 3D desktop pet."]
3: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Buddy", "Desktop companions react to your workflow, play animations, and keep you company throughout the day.", "Choose My Path"]
4: ["Don't worry! You can change your pet's nickname anytime later in desktop settings."]
5: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Desktop Pets", "Sign in with your existing account to instantly restore your pets and sync your progress across devices."]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your desktop pet companion is officially registered and ready to join your desktop workspace."]
7: ["Initializing pet animations and preparing desktop companion launcher..."]
8: ["System Tray Quick Access", "Your pet icon lives in your desktop system tray for easy access to settings and companion state.", "Next Step", "Desktop Companion Visibility", "Your pet sits comfortably over active windows. Use hotkeys or tray settings to hide or summon it.", "Complete Onboarding"]
9: ["You can safely minimize this window. Your desktop pet will notify you the moment it's ready!"]
